summary: Evidence GC's alert threshold cap_records rises from 45,000 to 150,000 records, about twice the live set of 73,782 measured in a dry run on 2026-11-05. Over the cap, GC still deletes every dead tree and key but exits 3 and alerts every night; the cap never decides what is deleted.

replay.detail: No stored data is read or written differently.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: Only the threshold at which scripts/evidence-gc exits 3 changes; its plan and deletions are the same.

manual.detail: Nothing to do; GC reads the file from main on its next run.
